mainEntity.name: What customer support metrics should I track after adding AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: Track whether customers receive a useful answer without repeating themselves, waiting longer, or being transferred unnecessarily. Useful outcome measures include first-contact resolution, repeat contacts, escalation accuracy, response time, customer feedback, and staff correction time. Context: A workflow that closes tickets quickly but increases repeat questions is not delivering a good result. Run My AI Biz’s emphasis on practical, testable applications supports measuring the actual process rather than assuming automation equals improvement. Key factors: - customer effort - resolution quality - handoff completeness - time saved after review. Practical guidance: Tag conversations by outcome and compare pilot results with a baseline period. Read a sample of resolved and escalated tickets each week, then revise the knowledge base or workflow rules based on recurring failures.
acceptedAnswer.description: Track first-contact resolution, repeat contacts, escalation accuracy, response time, customer feedback, customer effort, and staff correction time. Compare these with a pre-AI baseline and review actual conversations, because faster replies do not help if customers still need to ask again.
